sections.title: Collapsible detail box
sections.what: Creates the expandable box. The summary line is always visible, and the content appears only when the user opens it.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the app show optional source details without taking up space. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The default empty class name is trimmed, so extra spaces in class names are removed, which is harmless but easy to misread.

summary: A small wrapper that shows a collapsible section with a summary line and hidden details the user can open.
purpose: Lets the app hide source and trace details behind a click so the main view stays simple.
why: Likely reason: keeps technical detail available without crowding the page. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Takes a summary line and any content, places the content inside a collapsible box, and adds the class names passed in along with its own class.
inputs: A summary text, the content to show when opened, and an optional class name.
outputs: A collapsible block in the page with the summary as its clickable heading.
risks: The summary is shown as plain text, so if it is empty the user sees a clickable box with no label.
debug: If the box does not open, check that the content is actually passed as children. If styling looks wrong, check the traceability-details class names in the stylesheet.
